summary: Content exhibits multiple brand compliance concerns: 1 unverified promotional claim, 1 casing violation of proprietary brand terminology, and 1 informal tone construct. Final publication approval requires human review.

findings.title: Brand Name Capitalization Inconsistency
findings.message: Product name 'inkloom' is written in lowercase without proper camel-case styling specified in brand identity guidelines.
findings.evidence: Try inkloom today for best-in-class workflows.
findings.source_reference: Brand Identity Guidelines v2.4, Section 3.1: Naming & Trademarks
findings.suggested_correction: Try Inkloom AI today for best-in-class workflows.

findings.title: Unsubstantiated Performance Claim
findings.message: Superlative claim '100% error-free guarantee' lacks verifiable empirical proof in the corporate claim registry and exposes marketing to regulatory challenge.
findings.evidence: Our system delivers a 100% error-free guarantee across all media.
findings.suggested_correction: Our system delivers rigorous, multi-stage compliance verification across all media.

findings.title: Colloquial Phrasing in Enterprise Copy
findings.message: Use of colloquial filler 'super pumped' deviates from our professional and authoritative enterprise brand voice standard.
findings.evidence: We are super pumped to announce this capability.
findings.source_reference: Editorial Voice & Tone Standard v1.2, Principle 2: Authoritative yet Accessible
findings.suggested_correction: We are proud to announce this capability.
